Name: Horse to Vehicle Sound Converter
Author: SayonLiberty2
Description:
[b]Have you altered your horse into some kind of motorized vehicle?  

Is it producing clopping noises as if it were a horse ?  

Would you prefer that said vehicle sounded like a vehicle rather than a horse?   [/b]

[i][b]Well then use this mod, that is its purpose.  [/b][/i]

[u][b]Requires: Platonymous's Custom Music Mod [/b][/u]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043

Installation Instructions:
Step 0: Install [b]SMAPI
[/b]Step 1: Install Content Patcher
Step 2: Install [b]Pytk[/b]
Step 3: Install [u][b]Platonymous's Custom Music Mod[/b][/u]
Step 4: Install [i]This Mod[/i] by unpacking the zip file and placing the folder "Horse to Vehicle" in your [b]Mods[/b] Folder
Step 5: Enjoy your new lifestyle 


Prefer No Sound?  Well, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3946892]MissCoriel[/url] has you covered. 
Just use [i]"No Clop If It's Not a Horse it Shouldn't Gallop Mod"[/i]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5780
